Legal information

Terms and cancellation policy

Translation for information only. The Czech version is legally binding.

These terms govern accommodation at the Panel holiday complex, Oslnovice ev. č. 52, 671 07 Uherčice (the "complex"). The operator is Dajpr s.r.o., company ID 05753040, registered at Nové Syrovice 141, 675 41 Nové Syrovice (the "host").

1. Type of rental

  1. From September to June the complex is let exclusively as a whole to one group (the "guest"). During this time it is closed to the public.
  2. In July and August individual apartments are let, and a seasonal snack bar, shop and rental service operate on site.
  3. Maximum capacity is 29 people in fixed beds and 8 on extra beds. Capacity may not be exceeded.

2. Booking and payment

  1. Bookings are made through the booking system, by e-mail or by phone.
  2. The booking is binding once an advance payment of 50% of the price is paid, due within 14 days of the advance invoice being issued.
  3. The balance is due no later than the day of arrival.
  4. Electricity is charged by actual consumption (CZK 8/kWh), including heating and any EV charging, based on meter readings at arrival and departure.
  5. When individual apartments are let in summer (July and August), electricity and the cleaning fee are not charged.
  6. The tourist tax is charged under the municipal bylaw, currently CZK 20 per person per night.

3. Security deposit

  1. On arrival the guest pays a refundable cash security deposit: CZK 5,000 (2 nights), CZK 7,000 (3–6 nights), CZK 10,000 (7 nights or more).
  2. No security deposit is required when individual apartments are let in summer.
  3. On departure, electricity used (per meter reading), extra cleaning (for excessive soiling) and any other charges and damage are deducted from the security deposit. The rest is refunded on the spot.

4. Cleaning

Check-in/check-out handover, standard cleaning and bed linen are added to the booking per the current price list when renting the whole property. Exceptional soiling is charged at cost, CZK 350 per person per hour.

5. Cancellation

  1. Cancellation more than 60 days before arrival: free of charge, the advance payment is refunded.
  2. Cancellation 60 days or less before arrival: cancellation fee equal to the advance payment (50% of the price).
  3. No refund is given for no-shows or early departure.
  4. Changing the booking dates costs CZK 1,000.
  5. Cancellations must be made in writing to info@panelcz.cz.

6. Arrival and departure

Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 10:00. Late check-out up to 13:00 is possible by arrangement for CZK 100 per hour or part thereof.

7. Liability

  1. The guest is liable for damage to the host's property caused by anyone in their group.
  2. Guests use the wellness facilities (saunas, hot tub, pool) at their own risk in line with the house rules. Children only under adult supervision. The pool is not fenced. It has a sliding cover, which we recommend keeping closed whenever nobody is swimming so that no small child or animal can fall in. When the cover is open, an adult must supervise the pool at all times.
  3. The host is not liable for items left outside the locked apartments.

8. Dispute resolution

Consumers have the right to out-of-court dispute resolution with the Czech Trade Inspection Authority (www.coi.cz). These terms apply to bookings made from 9 November 2026.
